about_the_game:
The Motorcycle Ride: Infinity – Demo offers a brief but pure look into the core riding experience of the full game. Simple, uninterrupted, and immersive.

  • One motorcycle.

  • One infinite highway.

  • No goals, no finish line.

Just the open road, your favorite music, and the freedom to ride. There are no races, no timers, no complicated mechanics—only the joy of motion.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 @ 2.8 GHz or AMD Ryzen 5 2600
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1050 Ti or AMD Radeon RX 560
  • Storage: 5 GB available space

short_description: A minimalist motorcycle riding experience. One bike, one endless highway, no finish line—just ride, relax, and enjoy the road.
